In my free time, I enjoy hiking, cooking and spending time with my family. I hope to use my privilege to advance social justice and create a brighter future for generations to come. How much more, if anything, needs to be done to ensure equal rights for all Americans regardless of their racial or ethnic backgrounds?

 (B) Nothing at all

While we've made significant progress in the fight for equal rights in the United States, there is still a long way to go.
